title: The Law of the Honest Hand
description: No transaction shall be made without truth laid bare. Every deal must disclose all consequences, including environmental impact. The burden of truth falls on the seller, and the burden of consequence falls on the buyer.
author: Ankha
body:
Core Provisions (Finalized & Refined):
1. Truth in Exchange
   - Disclosure Requirement: All transactions must reveal all consequences (side effects, hidden costs, environmental harm).
   - Accessibility Clause: Disclosures must be made in the language and form accessible to the receiving party (oral recitation, visual aids, or community interpreters as needed).
   - Backroom Bargain Regulation: Magical deception tools (e.g., Backroom Bargain) must be disclosed. The crime is undisclosed deception, not deception itself.

2. Public Memory & Accountability
   - Victim-Carved Names: Offenders’ names are carved into the Dockside Pillars by victims (or their chosen proxy). Carvings must include:
     - The specific lie told.
     - The discovered truth.
     - A rebuttal space for the accused to respond within one week.
   - Story Stones: Pillars become a living archive of narratives, not just punishments.

3. Punishments (Scaled & Proportional)
   - Asset-Scaled Fines: 20% of total assets (not daily income) for first offenses. Repeat offenders face escalating penalties.
   - Perpetrator-Shared Air: Environmental immersion for systemic or ongoing violations only.
     - *Minor infraction (first offense):** 3 days.
     - Moderate infraction: 1 week.
     - *Severe infraction (repeat/grave harm):** 1 month.
   - Mandatory Testimony: Victims speak directly to offenders in a public forum.

4. Definitions (Clarified)
   - Transaction: Any exchange of value (tangible/intangible) between two or more parties with agreed-upon terms. Excludes political speech unless tied to direct exchange.
   - Consequences: Includes all foreseeable harms (physical, financial, environmental).
